title: L’Oréal to Sol de Janeiro: brands shaping the future of beauty travel retail in 2026
summary: Travel retail is proving itself to be the secret home of luxury in 2026. But as dupes give rise to a consumer who wants value over quality, Cosmetics Business explores why more beauty brands are investing in, and bolstering, their travel retail offering this year
